root_cause: The authored Python fixture text contained the JavaScript replacement metasequence dollar-plus-single-quote. Passing the entire appended test text as String.replace's replacement string expanded that metasequence to the suffix after the replacement match and inserted an actual newline plus unittest.main() inside a Python short string. Published bytes matched the erroneous authored bytes; exact blob readback alone was not Python syntax verification.

exact_delta.before:
valid.replace('          ref: ' + CANDIDATE, '          ref: 
    unittest.main()
 + '{{ github.sha }}'),
exact_delta.after: valid.replace('          ref: ' + CANDIDATE, '          ref: ' + chr(36) + '{{ github.sha }}'),

authoring_fix: Applied the unique replacement via a callback, so JavaScript performs no replacement-string metasequence expansion. The fixture constructs the dollar with chr(36). Existing correctly escaped duplicate-YAML newline fixtures remain unchanged.
